fact: POL-TAX-006 TDS Policy v1.1 is effective from 1 April 2026 and owned by Meera Kulkarni.
The approved TDS Section Table decides the section and rate; past invoices only suggest one; a new row is proposed by the tax manager and approved by the financial controller.

Purchase of goods: Income-tax Act 2025 section 393(1), Table Sl. No. 8(ii) (formerly section 194Q): 0.1% of purchases above Rs.50,00,000 from one supplier in a financial year, because Northbridge's turnover is above Rs.10 crore.
With no PAN, or an inoperative PAN, TDS on a purchase of goods is 5% (formerly section 206AA).
No TDS on freight paid to a transporter owning not more than 10 goods carriages who gives its PAN and a declaration (formerly section 194C(6)).
A lower or nil deduction certificate is used only after it is verified on TRACES.
TDS is deposited by the 7th of the following month.
The quarterly TDS return is Form 140 (formerly Form 26Q); for October to December it is due by 31 January.
The TDS certificate to the supplier is Form 131 (formerly Form 16A).
POL-TAX-007 Reverse Charge Policy v1.0 is effective from 1 November 2026 and owned by Meera Kulkarni.
Reverse-charge GST is paid in cash only, never from input tax credit (CGST Act section 49(4)).
For services under reverse charge, the tax is due on the earlier of the payment date and the 61st day after the supplier's invoice date.
For a supplier that is not registered, a self-invoice is issued within 30 days of receiving the service (Rule 47A).

Goods transport by a goods transport agency that has not opted to charge GST: reverse charge at 5% (Notification 13/2017). Other rows in force from 1 November 2026: entry 2 legal services 18%, entry 5AB renting of property by an unregistered person 18%, entry 6 director's services 18%, entry 14 security staff 18%.

Cab or bus hire with fuel from a non-body-corporate not charging 18%: reverse charge at 5%, valid from 1 November 2026 (Notification 8/2026); the earlier row (not charging 12%) applied until 31 October 2026. Credit on entry 15 is blocked unless the vehicle has more than 13 seats.
